summary: Allocates a per-surface decode descriptor through the media allocator, stores its address at this+0x19C, and fills a per-sub-surface function-pointer table choosing among passthrough, zero-init, byte-duplicate, interleave, pixel-blend, resample, and track-map-fill routines based on surface format flags, dimensions, scale factors, and channel count. Performs an aligned secondary allocation for the output buffer and writes integer scale factors for the track-map case. Unsupported formats raise errors 23 and 37 through the error object.

operations.description: Call the allocator through vtable slot 0 of this+0x4 with (this, 1, 160); the returned descriptor pointer is used as the base for the routine table.
Store the allocated descriptor pointer at this+0x19C and clear the byte at descriptor+8.
Initialize descriptor entries: slot 0 = VehicleStructFieldCopy, slot 1 = AudioBufferMixing.
If the byte at this+0x108 is set, write error code 23 to obj+0x14 and dispatch the error through obj vtable slot 0.
Compute v18 = (byte at this+0x48 set) && (this+0x114 > 1); used to select the blended filter path.
Run the population loop only when the sub-surface count at this+0x20 is greater than 0.
Iterate the sub-surface descriptor array at this+0xC4, advancing 84 bytes per element.
Per element, scale source dimensions by the factor at this+0x114, compare the results against target widths at this+0x10C and this+0x110, and store a scaled value in the descriptor table.
Branch on the element flag byte at *(this+0xC4)+0x30: when clear, the element routine is set to PtrInitZero.

Select the element copy routine when scaled size differs from target: identity SetterReturnA4 when sizes match; half-resolution with channel count at *(this+0xC4)+0x28 greater than 2 uses PixelBlendFilterHorizontal else MonochromeBufferByteDuplicateCopy; quarter-resolution uses ImageResampleFilter (marking descriptor+8) or BufferInterleaveCopy.

On a non-integer scale (remainder present), write error code 37 to obj+0x14 and dispatch through obj vtable; otherwise select TrackMapPixelFill and store the 8-bit integer scale factors at descriptor+140 and descriptor+150.
Secondary allocation: call slot 8 of the this+0x4 allocator vtable with (this, 1, AlignUp(this+0x5C, this+0x10C), this+0x110) and store the returned buffer pointer in the descriptor.

clean_pseudocode: // choose routine per element and write into desc table
unresolved: The exact media container and codec identity behind the 84-byte sub-surface descriptor layout are unknown.

The semantics of the nine corpus-labeled routine pointers (VehicleStructFieldCopy, AudioBufferMixing, SetterReturnA4, PtrInitZero, TrackMapPixelFill, MonochromeBufferByteDuplicateCopy, BufferInterleaveCopy, PixelBlendFilterHorizontal, ImageResampleFilter) are corpus labels, not runtime-proven behavior.
The allocator and secondary-alignment helpers behind the this+0x4 vtable are unverified.
Single known static caller is sub_516C7B; no frame-path evidence.
